intro: Bliss lets your comfort take the spotlight. Our Bliss dining chair combines plush cushioning and a high-back design with solid Sheesham strength and timeless walnut tones.

features.title: Warm walnut appeal
features.text: Wrapped in an elegant walnut finish, your chair adds a refined, welcoming charm to your dining area.

features.title: Sit soft, sit long
features.text: Bliss' cushioned seat and back, upholstered in soft light brown fabric, make every mealtime feel like a gentle pause.

features.title: Built to last, crafted with care
features.text: Solid Sheesham wood construction ensures strength and durability—this is a chair made to stay.

features.title: Support that hugs you
features.text: With its tall backrest, your chair offers ergonomic support that’s perfect for lingering conversations.

features.title: Style with support
features.text: The high back provides you with added support and contrasts beautifully with the frame, creating a look that's both classic and fresh.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
